muc.title: AI looks things up online
muc.text: When AI answers recent news with links, it has turned on web search: it's looking things up online itself.

muc.title: Web search checks a few pages
muc.text: Web search quickly checks a few pages and summarizes them, good for the weather or movie times.

muc.title: Deep Research reads deeply
muc.text: Deep Research reads dozens of sources in a few minutes, then writes a long report with citations.

muc.title: Click the links
muc.text: Even with web search, AI can misread things, so click a few links to see what the sources really say.

muc.title: Turn on search, open two links
muc.text: Turn on web search in a chatbot, ask about something from this week, then open two of the links it gives to check.
